title: LLM Defenses Are Not Robust to Multi-Turn Human Jailbreaks Yet
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on the security and robustness of Large Language Model (LLM) safety filters against adversarial multi-turn jailbreaking attacks. It evaluates these defenses using datasets like HarmBench and the authors' own MHJ dataset. While the jailbreak content includes categories like harassment or offensive language, the study aims to benchmark the technical failure of refusal mechanisms rather than to evaluate religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or formal ethical frameworks.
